# Third-party material

mermaid-diag (MIT, Phillip Gomez) bundles:

| What | Where | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Mermaid 12.2.0 (`mermaid.min.js`, which bundles ELK, DOMPurify, KaTeX and others) | `js/mermaid.min.js` | MIT, `js/LICENSE-mermaid.txt` |
| The headless DOM (`dom_shim.js`) and path bounds (`path_bbox.js`) from mermaidx 0.10.1, with mermaid-diag's changes marked `mermaid-diag:` / `Patch:` | `js/` | MIT, `js/LICENSE-mermaidx.txt` |
| IBM Plex Sans, Mono and Serif (woff2, and TTFs converted from them) | `fonts/` | SIL Open Font License 1.1, `fonts/OFL.txt` |
